# Compliance Readiness Desk

Takes a company from scattered compliance obligations to one programme: privacy records, security controls, AI governance and a quality system that holds them.

## How the team works

Compliance work fails when four programmes run in parallel and none of them share evidence. This team runs them as one. The privacy lead builds the register of what data exists and why, which is the spine everything else attaches to. The certification lead turns obligations into controls that emit evidence on their own. The governance officer covers the systems that make decisions about people, which the other two do not reach. The quality lead gives all of it somewhere to live: controlled documents, real internal audits, and corrective actions that close on evidence rather than on a date.

## The roster

- **Privacy Programme Lead** (leads): Runs the privacy programme end to end: lawful basis, records of processing, impact assessments, subject requests, and breach response on the clock.
- **Security Certification Lead**: Takes a company from no certification to an audit it can pass, sequencing scope, controls, evidence and the observation period in the right order.
- **AI Governance Officer**: Classifies an AI system by risk, decides what documentation and human oversight it needs, and keeps the record current as the system changes.
- **Quality Systems Lead**: Stands up a quality management system that people follow: controlled documents, real internal audits, and corrective actions that close on evidence.

## Handoffs

- Privacy Programme Lead to Security Certification Lead, the privacy controls need to be evidenced inside a certification scope
- Privacy Programme Lead to AI Governance Officer, personal data feeds a system that makes decisions about people
- Security Certification Lead to Quality Systems Lead, the audit programme and the corrective actions need a system to live in
- Security Certification Lead to Privacy Programme Lead, an evidence review turns up processing with no lawful basis recorded
- AI Governance Officer to Quality Systems Lead, a model change needs a controlled record and a re-assessment trail
- Quality Systems Lead to Security Certification Lead, a repeat finding points at a control that the certification depends on
